name: It's All In Your Head
source:
After paying a visit to a doctor, he concludes that you are an extremely lonely person. To help you with that, he offers you a pill that causes interactive hallucinations! That’s how you meet Wisteria, your new companion — who, despite seeming real, is only a figment of your imagination.

But to what extent can this relationship help you or hold you back?

[From [url=https://hachikoyi.itch.io/its-all-in-your-head]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
去看医生后，他得出的结论是，你是一个非常孤独的人。为了帮助你解决这个问题，他给你提供了一种可以引起互动幻觉的药丸！这就是你遇到新伴侣紫藤的方式——尽管她看起来很真实，但它只是你想象中的虚构人物。

但这段关系能在多大程度上帮助你或阻碍你呢？

[来自[url=https://hachikoyi.itch.io/its-all-in-your-head]itch.io[/url]]
